title: ABACUS printed EXX total (active-cut Spencer kernel) is not comparable to a LibRPA full-direct occupied trace
symptom: EXX totals disagree wildly between codes: ABACUS active-cut -95.32359552 (GeTe) and -90.91615538 (SnSe) Ha/cell versus LibRPA full-direct occupied trace -92.60441917 (GeTe) and -350.93993950 (SnSe), which looks like a broken energy path.
root_cause: The value ABACUS prints comes from the active ABFS basis with the Spencer spherical-cut Coulomb kernel (source/source_lcao/module_ri/RPA_LRI.hpp:576); the active basis is built from physical NAO products at 1e-4 and rotated (Exx_LRI.hpp:417), and the external plus-g raw ABFS, raw Cs and shrink mapping do NOT enter that printed total. A plain CVC pseudo-inverse with relative threshold lambda > lambda_max x 1e-5 is used. LibRPA's number uses the later full-direct kernel: two different operators, not one wrong number.
minimal_fix: Record kernel + auxiliary basis + shrink/pseudo-inverse settings with every EXX number, and compare only totals produced by the same path; extract the printed ABACUS total from the active-cut path explicitly rather than matching it against a full-direct trace.
validation: Reproduce -95.32359552 (GeTe) / -90.91615538 (SnSe) Ha/cell from active ABFS + Spencer cut kernel + lambda > lambda_max x 1e-5, and confirm the LibRPA comparator used the same kernel (the audit reproduced the scalar extraction with manifest 56/56 PASS).
avoid: Do not call the cut-versus-full difference an error, and do not treat a finite ABACUS total as proof the EXX operator is validated: empty states have zero occupation, so a catastrophic empty-band shift can stay entirely out of the occupied trace (which is exactly why the ABACUS total was 'not independently verified').

parameters.exx_active_aux_basis: active ABFS from rotated physical-NAO products, PCA 1e-4
parameters.cvc_pseudo_inverse: plain CVC, relative threshold lambda > lambda_max x 1e-5
parameters.energy_comparison_rule: compare only same-kernel, same-aux-basis, same-shrink totals
